name: Module transfer machine
summary: Precision equipment for automatic transfer of electronic modules between different workstations, supporting multiple product sizes.
contentHtml:
The module transfer machine is an automated equipment developed by TXAM for electronic module transfer.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a precision motion control system to achieve accurate module transfer between multiple workstations. Combined with a vision positioning system, it adapts to precise transfer of products of different sizes.

Technical Advantages

  • High transfer accuracy with precise product positioning
  • Supports multi-station configuration with high flexibility
  • High degree of automation, reducing manual intervention
  • Easy changeover, adaptable to multi-variety production
